system.description:
The mage feels the inner structure of a mechanism and coaxes its parts to move, slipping tumblers, easing bolts, or freeing a stuck latch. At rank 2 the caster manipulates the shape and state of worked matter without force. It reads coincidentally as a skilled hand with picks or a lucky jiggle of the handle.

Dice Pool: Dexterity + Larceny (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Matter 2; mechanics paraphrased.
